identity_accounts_disabled_state.name: identity_accounts_disabled_state
identity_accounts_disabled_state.value: ("identity_accounts"."status" = 'active' AND "identity_accounts"."disabled_at" IS NULL) OR ("identity_accounts"."status" = 'disabled' AND "identity_accounts"."disabled_at" IS NOT NULL)

identity_security_events_actor_account.name: identity_security_events_actor_account
identity_security_events_actor_account.value: ("identity_security_events"."actor_kind" = 'account' AND "identity_security_events"."actor_account_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("identity_security_events"."actor_kind" <> 'account' AND "identity_security_events"."actor_account_id" IS NULL)

identity_security_events_session_account.name: identity_security_events_session_account
identity_security_events_session_account.value: ("identity_security_events"."session_id" IS NULL AND "identity_security_events"."account_id" IS NULL) OR ("identity_security_events"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "identity_security_events"."account_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("identity_security_events"."session_id" IS NULL AND "identity_security_events"."account_id" IS NOT NULL)

initial_passkey_enrollments_terminal_sta.name: initial_passkey_enrollments_terminal_state
initial_passkey_enrollments_terminal_sta.value: NOT ("initial_passkey_enrollments"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "initial_passkey_enrollments"."invalidated_at" IS NOT NULL)

oauth_clients_disabled_state.name: oauth_clients_disabled_state
oauth_clients_disabled_state.value: ("oauth_clients"."status" = 'active' AND "oauth_clients"."disabled_at" IS NULL) OR ("oauth_clients"."status" = 'disabled' AND "oauth_clients"."disabled_at" IS NOT NULL)

oauth_interactions_account_session_pair.name: oauth_interactions_account_session_pair
oauth_interactions_account_session_pair.value: ("oauth_interactions"."account_id" IS NULL AND "oauth_interactions"."session_id" IS NULL AND "oauth_interactions"."grant_id" IS NULL) OR ("oauth_interactions"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_interactions"."session_id" IS NOT NULL)

oauth_interactions_terminal_state.name: oauth_interactions_terminal_state
oauth_interactions_terminal_state.value: ("oauth_interactions"."status" = 'pending' AND "oauth_interactions"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "oauth_interactions"."abandoned_at" IS NULL) OR ("oauth_interactions"."status" = 'completed' AND "oauth_interactions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_interactions"."abandoned_at" IS NULL) OR ("oauth_interactions"."status" = 'abandoned' AND "oauth_interactions"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "oauth_interactions"."abandoned_at" IS NOT NULL)

oauth_refresh_families_reuse_revokes.name: oauth_refresh_families_reuse_revokes
oauth_refresh_families_reuse_revokes.value: "oauth_refresh_token_families"."reuse_detected_at" IS NULL OR ("oauth_refresh_token_families"."reuse_detected_at" >= "oauth_refresh_token_families"."created_at" AND "oauth_refresh_token_families"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_refresh_token_families"."revoked_at" <= "oauth_refresh_token_families"."reuse_detected_at")

oauth_refresh_tokens_replacement_consume.name: oauth_refresh_tokens_replacement_consumed
oauth_refresh_tokens_replacement_consume.value: "oauth_refresh_tokens"."replaced_by_generation" IS NULL OR "oauth_refresh_tokens"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL

oauth_sessions_amr_nonempty.name: oauth_sessions_amr_nonempty
oauth_sessions_amr_nonempty.value: cardinality("oauth_sessions"."amr") > 0 AND array_position("oauth_sessions"."amr", NULL) IS NULL

oauth_sessions_passkey_binding.name: oauth_sessions_passkey_binding
oauth_sessions_passkey_binding.value: array_position("oauth_sessions"."amr", 'passkey') IS NULL OR "oauth_sessions"."webauthn_credential_id" IS NOT NULL

oauth_signing_keys_activated_after_publi.name: oauth_signing_keys_activated_after_publish
oauth_signing_keys_activated_after_publi.value: "oauth_signing_keys"."activated_at" IS NULL OR ("oauth_signing_keys"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_signing_keys"."activated_at" >= "oauth_signing_keys"."published_at")

oauth_signing_keys_stopped_after_activat.name: oauth_signing_keys_stopped_after_activation
oauth_signing_keys_stopped_after_activat.value: "oauth_signing_keys"."signing_stopped_at" IS NULL OR ("oauth_signing_keys"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_signing_keys"."signing_stopped_at" >= "oauth_signing_keys"."activated_at")

oauth_signing_keys_retired_after_stop.name: oauth_signing_keys_retired_after_stop
oauth_signing_keys_retired_after_stop.value: "oauth_signing_keys"."retired_at" IS NULL OR ("oauth_signing_keys"."signing_stopped_at" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_signing_keys"."retired_at" >= "oauth_signing_keys"."signing_stopped_at")

oauth_signing_keys_lifecycle_state.name: oauth_signing_keys_lifecycle_state
oauth_signing_keys_lifecycle_state.value: ("oauth_signing_keys"."status" = 'staged' AND "oauth_signing_keys"."activated_at" IS NULL AND "oauth_signing_keys"."signing_stopped_at" IS NULL AND "oauth_signing_keys"."retired_at" IS NULL AND "oauth_signing_keys"."revoked_at" IS NULL) OR ("oauth_signing_keys"."status" = 'active' AND "oauth_signing_keys"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_signing_keys"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_signing_keys"."signing_stopped_at" IS NULL AND "oauth_signing_keys"."retired_at" IS NULL AND "oauth_signing_keys"."revoked_at" IS NULL) OR ("oauth_signing_keys"."status" = 'verifying' AND "oauth_signing_keys"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_signing_keys"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_signing_keys"."signing_stopped_at" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_signing_keys"."retired_at" IS NULL AND "oauth_signing_keys"."revoked_at" IS NULL) OR ("oauth_signing_keys"."status" = 'retired' AND "oauth_signing_keys"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_signing_keys"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_signing_keys"."signing_stopped_at" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_signing_keys"."retired_at" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_signing_keys"."revoked_at" IS NULL) OR ("oauth_signing_keys"."status" = 'revoked' AND "oauth_signing_keys"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

totp_credentials_active_account_uq.name: totp_credentials_active_account_uq
totp_credentials_active_account_uq.where: "totp_credentials"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "totp_credentials"."revoked_at" IS NULL

totp_recovery_sessions_terminal_state.name: totp_recovery_sessions_terminal_state
totp_recovery_sessions_terminal_state.value: NOT ("totp_recovery_sessions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "totp_recovery_sessions"."invalidated_at" IS NOT NULL)

webauthn_credentials_active_account_labe.name: webauthn_credentials_active_account_label_uq
webauthn_credentials_active_account_labe.where: "webauthn_credentials"."label" IS NOT NULL AND "webauthn_credentials"."revoked_at" IS NULL
